SELECT 
    l.stationname,
    l.locationtype,
    w.waterqualityindex,
    w.waterlevelpercent,
    w.wastetanklevelpercent,
    w.waterlevelpercent * (CAST(w.waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100) * (1 - CAST(w.wastetanklevelpercent AS numeric) / 100) AS wrmi
FROM waterandwaste w
JOIN location l ON w.watereqref = l.loceqref
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    l.stationname,
    l.locationtype,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(w.waterqualityindex) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_water_quality_index,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(w.waterlevelpercent * (CAST(w.waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100) * (1 - CAST(w.wastetanklevelpercent AS numeric) / 100)) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_wrmi,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN w.waterlevelpercent * (CAST(w.waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100) * (1 - CAST(w.wastetanklevelpercent AS numeric) / 100) < 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS systems_needing_water_saving,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(w.waterqualityindex) >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
        WHEN AVG(w.waterqualityindex) >= 71 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN AVG(w.waterqualityindex) >= 51 THEN 'Moderate'
        WHEN AVG(w.waterqualityindex) >= 26 THEN 'Poor'
        ELSE 'Unsafe'
    END AS water_quality_classification,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(w.waterlevelpercent * (CAST(w.waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100) * (1 - CAST(w.wastetanklevelpercent AS numeric) / 100)) < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed'
        WHEN AVG(w.waterlevelpercent * (CAST(w.waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100) * (1 - CAST(w.wastetanklevelpercent AS numeric) / 100)) >= 0.5 
             AND AVG(w.waterlevelpercent * (CAST(w.waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100) * (1 - CAST(w.wastetanklevelpercent AS numeric) / 100)) < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised'
        ELSE 'Sustainable Management'
    END AS management_situation
FROM waterandwaste w
JOIN location l ON w.watereqref = l.loceqref
GROUP BY l.stationname, l.locationtype
ORDER BY l.stationname, l.locationtype;
